Lotus Palace's Best Employee

General

Rarity

Super Epic

Bonus

+200 pts for Hydrangea Flower Jellies

Costume Owner

Hydrangea Cookie

Release Date

May 12, 2023 (11:00 GMT +9)

Obtained By

Costume Gacha
80 (1.08% pull rate)

Limited

No

“ I will always stand by the Great Dragon's side! „

Lotus Palace's Best Employee (Korean: 백련성 최고관리, baengnyonssong chwegogwalri, "Top Manager of the Lotus Palace") is a Super Epic Costume for Hydrangea Cookie. It is her first Costume, released in the second half of the Rise of the Blue Dragon update. It can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story[]

Oh, majestic Blue Dragon, heed my words and tread carefully, for danger lurks around every corner! As the best employee of the Lotus Palace, it is the Cookie's duty to adorn the armors with the most exquisite lotus petals and leaves that bloom at dawn. So let us keep our sight firmly ahead and move forward fearlessly...!

Quotes[]

General[]

  • I will always stand by the Great Dragon's side!
  • Why settle for less when you can have more?
  • I'll put off the flower viewing for later.
  • I am merely following the Great Dragon's guidance.
  • I shall weave together these petals as a symbol of the victory!

Tired[]

  • I'm too tired...

Lobby[]

Daily Gift[]

  • Would you like to join me in serving the Great Dragon?

Tap[]

  • Welcome! The Great Dragon is waiting for you!
  • The Great Dragon has awoken!
  • Let's admire the blossoming flowers together when the typhoon passes!
  • Wow, thank you! Did my efforts show?
  • There is no time to waste when serving the Great Dragon!
  • The palace has been quite busy lately!
  • Like the phases of the moon, constantly changing and evolving.
  • The fate of this land rests solely in the hands of the Great Dragon!

Gift[]

  • I'll adorn the Great Dragon's armor with it! (Given Blooming Hydrangeas)
  • Wow! I needed this! (Given Royal Golden Dough)
  • Where should I put this? (Neutral)

The following are reused from the Cookie's base quotes.

General[]

  • So many flowers! I will relax here for a bit.
  • The Great Dragon calls? I will go a bit later!
  • No, these aren't tears. They're droplets of water.
  • Flowers bloom and wilt all the time.
  • Do not worry about such frivolous things.

Trivia[]

  • Lotus Palace's Best Employee was released alongside Slithering Strategist.
